discovery-weak-signals.name: Grid and electrification buildout
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Record backlog and demand across transmission/distribution and commercial-industrial electrical work indicate durable infrastructure workload.

expectations-execution.name: Operating execution
expectations-execution.basis: Revenue, earnings, EBITDA and backlog reached records while gross margin expanded.

items.risk: Backlog is not equivalent to guaranteed revenue; some master-service work can be canceled for convenience and timing/mix can move reported backlog.
Fixed-price execution errors, labor/material cost movement and project estimate revisions can reverse margin gains.
Backlog interpretation can overstate certainty if cancelable/master-service components are treated as firm contracted revenue.
Fixed-price project mix exposes margins to estimation and execution errors.
A portion of margin improvement came from changes in estimated project gross profit and favorable closeouts, which may not recur.
